evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 玉玲珑馆
evidence.excerpt_zh: 獅子林之南為玉玲瓏館正宇為正誼明道五楹北為林光澹碧東為鶴安齋西南為蹈和堂（長春園册）臣等謹案林光澹碧宇内額曰逰心於淡
evidence.summary: South of 獅子林: 玉玲瓏館, main range 正誼明道 of five bays, with 林光澹碧, 鶴安齋 and 蹈和堂.

evidence.title: 蹈和堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.4, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 8-853
evidence.excerpt_zh: 元气化工氲，醇风万物欣。王褒讲德论，曹植事神文。静挹筦倪趣，闲披翰墨芬。四情皆中节，不敏愿尊闻。
evidence.summary: Poem 蹈和堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

evidence.title: 蹈和堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.10, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 9-454
evidence.excerpt_zh: 履贞济徽懿，率礼守安详。永念儿宽对，非循支父方。殷勤树禽语，自在砌花芳。协序惟旸雨，消闲有缥缃。
evidence.summary: Poem 蹈和堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

evidence.title: 题蹈和堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.4, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 9-102
evidence.excerpt_zh: 座有古芸披，甄陶左右宜。履贞兼纳顺，率礼复敦诗。省岁调元气，祈年协四时。与民同保合，念释总于兹。
evidence.summary: Poem 题蹈和堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1765, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 玉玲珑馆
evidence.summary: Built 1747, added to about 1764, on an island south of 狮子林. Gate five bays; main hall of seven (plaque 正谊明道), rear of nine (林光澹碧). West court has 撷景室, 蹈和堂 and the square 朝晖亭 on the water; the east has five-bay 鹤安斋, the double-eaved 狎鸥亭, 随安室, a greenhouse, a fountain, 澹然书屋 and 芥舟 at the shore.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 蹈和堂, 3x1 cells.
